conditions
conditions · 10 records
  1. Supply agreements can sometimes be cancelled/rescheduled/adjusted before firm orders; changes may have costs. Gross commitments are not automatically debt.
  2. Land/power/shell guarantees arise on partner default and decline over5–7years with partner payments; escrow reduces exposure but is not freely available NVIDIA cash.
  3. Aug10 >$500bn financing initiative is third-party capital target under MOUs; not NVIDIA cash, debt, backlog or booked revenue. Any support is project-specific.
  4. SBC remains an operating expense; do not add back future SBC and also ignore dilution. Unrecognized compensation is not the fair value of outstanding awards.
  5. Strategic equity carrying values include unrealized gains and require liquidity/valuation/tax review before adding to operating value.
  6. Separate additional36bn AI-cloud agreements are reduced by customer or NVIDIA capacity use; cloud partners can discontinue provision to NVIDIA and sell to third parties, with conditional revenue sharing. Do not confuse these with29bn own-R&D cloud agreements.
  7. Additional20bn uncommenced leases intended for reassignment to third parties are separate from25bn own-use uncommenced leases. Expected commencementFY2028–29, roughly15-year terms; intended reassignment is not completed transfer of obligations.
  8. August105bn SB Energy/OpenAI guarantee cap is post-balance-sheet but disclosed before cutoff. Nine phases, first expectedFY2029; tenant-default trigger, covered portions of20-year lease/power payments, exposure declines; terminates on specified credit-rating events or lease expiry. Option to support another3.8GW is discretionary, not committed cap.
  9. Do not double-count gross obligations against already modeled operating expenditures, working capital or recognized liabilities. Claims valuation needs default probability, phase timing, coverage, recovery, discounting and correlation with operating downside.
  10. 986m Groq license consideration remains accrued; classify consistently with operating working capital or financing bridge, never both.

invalidators
invalidators · 5 records
  1. AI infrastructure monetization or financing weakens; high indirect concentration persists despite more direct buyers.
  2. Memory/packaging/power constraints delay revenue and compress gross margin.
  3. Export restrictions or tariffs produce inventory write-downs and lost market access.
  4. Custom silicon, open ecosystems or price/performance substitution reduce platform share/rents.
  5. Extended payment terms and supply commitments create working-capital and contingent-credit exposure not visible in low physical-capex ratios.

methodology
Original immediately preceding-quarter guidance versus first published same-period actual; all values native USD. No analyst estimates. Revenue range is +/-2%; margin range +/-0.5 percentage points. Missing guidance is absent/null. Later revisions are separate and do not replace original forecasts. Beats are signed forecast errors, not a generic trust score.

rationale
rationale · 8 fields
growth
The old40% next-TTM assumption is difficult to reconcile with Q3$108bn and management preliminaryFY28+70%.80/45/25% staged next-TTM growth recognizes an elevated ramp while fading much faster after year3; it is not a direct70% transcription. Near-term fiscal reference: H1FY27 actual177.837bn + Q3guide108bn + analyticalQ4 120bn impliesFY27~405.837bn; management70% FY28 would imply~689.9bn. A nextTTM of545.346bn lies between those fiscal totals and remains conditional.
early Horizon
3 years capture current Blackwell/Rubin ramp and a subsequent adoption window; ten-year total is preferred to15/20 because visibility beyond the current platform/customer-capex cycle is weak. Bull15-year persistence tests a sustained platform, not higher certainty.
margin
Explicit annual operating margin should be62/59/56% in years1–3 then fade to45% byyear10, reflecting memory gross-margin guidance72–73%, compute/R&D cost, and scarcity normalization. GAAP margin afterSBC/DA; investment gains excluded.
reinvestment
2x incremental sales/net reinvestment is a forward judgment. Cash-flow AR/inventory growth and project support mean fabless does not imply capital-free; separate long-lived strategic investment and guarantee analysis is required.
tax
20% normalized versus16–18% FY27 management outlook; all model tax rates are operating assumptions.
discount
11% nominalUSD retained as a rounded risk judgment, not a live regression; test10–13%. Do not lower it mechanically because management beat near-term guidance.
terminal
2.5% nominal growth and25% terminalROIC preserve a substantial moat but force reinvestment10% of terminalNOPAT. No terminal ROIC equals historical book proxy.
claims
Keep bridge gated. Review debt, leases, awards, strategic equity, financing guarantees and post-quarter arrangements; null additional claims/assets means unresolved, not zero.
